title: AnnouncementUserStatusDetails
description: An announcement's status regarding whether it has been acknowledged by a user.

timeAcknowledged.description:
The date and time the announcement was acknowledged, expressed in [RFC 3339](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339) timestamp format.
Example: `2019-01-01T17:43:01.389+0000`

userId.description: The OCID of the user that this status is associated with.

userStatusAnnouncementId.description: The OCID of the announcement that this status is associated with.
